brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to test the safety and pharmacodynamics of an oral formulation of insulin in subjects with Type 2 Diabetes.
brief_title: Safety, Pharmacokinetics (PK) and Pharmacodynamics (PD) of Multiple Oral Bedtime Doses of ORMD-0801 in Adult Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (T2DM)
official_title: Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study to Assess the Safety, PK and PD of Multiple Oral Bedtime Doses of ORMD-0801 in Adult Patients With T2DM Who Are Inadequately Controlled With Diet and Exercise or Diet, Exercise and Metformin

primary_outcomes.measure: Evaluate the Safety and Tolerability of ORMD-0801.
